motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Hover and press feedback; disabled for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Pill-shaped share and pairing action; 36px desktop and 44px coarse-pointer target.
components.css: .button-primary { min-height:36px; padding:6px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:999px; background:#475569; color:#ffffff; font:550 15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .button-primary:hover { background:#334155; } .button-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #475569; outline-offset:3px; } @media (any-pointer:coarse) { .button-primary { min-height:44px; } } @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark) { .button-primary { background:#cbd5e1; color:#0f172a; } .button-primary:hover { background:#e2e8f0; } .button-primary:focus-visible { outline-color:#cbd5e1; } }

narrative.overview: Quiet sidebar, serif headings, generous space, and one share with its recipients together.

rules.name: Share hierarchy
rules.body: One card per share; recipients are rows within it.

dos: Keep the logo visible when navigation collapses.
donts: Do not add metric cards or decorative motion.
